thread:
Lin Ma: planning a fast cutover for the compact base image tomorrow 07:00 PT. want to lock RBAC + KMS signing window now so oncall knows when to expect signed artifacts.
Ethan Li: SG. current plan is to remove cluster-admin from ci-builder and bind a Role scoped to `infra-builds`. patch below.
```
# RBAC patch (k8s)
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: ci-builder-image-binder
  namespace: infra-builds
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: ci-builder
  namespace: infra-builds
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: image-baker
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```
Samira Gupta: please annotate the patch with `security.ticket=SEC-1043` and `operator` so audit logs are searchable. also require the patch to include `reason` in the request body for the API server so it shows up in audit metadata.
Nora Patel: KMS note: the signer key policy must grant `AsymmetricSign` to the CI principal only and forbid `Decrypt`/`Encrypt`. i've added a conditional to limit signing to artifacts with name prefix `compact-*`.
Ethan Li: cosign command we'll use in CI:
```
cosign sign --key kms://projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/base/cryptoKeys/signer --annotations "ticket=SEC-1043,operator=lin" registry.internal/compact:sha256-deadbeef
```
Samira Gupta: add an `X-Audit-Id` header on KMS requests from CI and surface that into our audit-forwarder so we can correlate KMS logs with k8s audit events.
kms-bot: checklist update: [RBAC annotated], [KMS policy reviewed], [X-Audit-Id present], [canary reserved].
Lin Ma: vuln triage: ops found a dropped legacy symlink that some monitoring binaries expect. not a CVE, but it fails the healthcheck. plan is to include a small compatibility shim in the image and add a canary test.
Ethan Li: for the canary we'll run with: `privileged: false`, seccomp: `compact-min.json`, capabilities: drop ALL. i'll add enforced asserts in the rollout pipeline.
Samira Gupta: enforce pipeline checks: `allowPrivilegeEscalation == false`, `securityContext.runAsNonRoot == true`, and `capabilities.drop includes ALL`. if any assertion fails, pipeline must stop and open a rollback PR.
Nora Patel: rollback plan if canary shows a security regression: immediately revoke `AsymmetricSign` on the KMS key, revoke cosign permissions, and revert image tag. ops will coordinate with oncall sec.
Ethan Li: i'll run syscall trace + seccomp fuzz against the canary nodes and post traces here before gate.
Samira Gupta: once Ethan posts traces, i'll do a quick audit-scan for the annotated RBAC change and KMS calls. target is green-by-18:00 PT.
Lin Ma: thanks all — i'll post the cutover ticket and ping 15m before. :thumbsup:
